purpose: Verify that an authorized Basic User can create an expense/voucher request and save it as Draft
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Basic User role
action_or_input: Invoke creation of an expense/voucher request and save as Draft
expected_result: The expense/voucher request is created in Draft status and saved

purpose: Verify that the request creator can enter request type, amount, department, description, and supporting information
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Basic User role and has an editable Draft request
action_or_input: Enter request type, amount, department, description, and supporting information on the Draft request
expected_result: The entered request type, amount, department, description, and supporting information are stored on the request

purpose: Verify that the request creator can attach supporting documents to an expense/voucher request
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Basic User role and has a Draft request
action_or_input: Attach a supporting document to the expense/voucher request
expected_result: The document attachment is successfully associated with the expense/voucher request

purpose: Verify that saving a Draft with missing submission-mandatory information is permitted and missing information is identified
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Basic User role
action_or_input: Save an expense/voucher Draft with submission-mandatory fields omitted
expected_result: The Draft request is successfully saved and the missing submission-mandatory information is identified by the system

purpose: Verify that a Basic User can submit a complete Draft expense/voucher request for formal processing
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Basic User role and has a complete Draft request with all required fields and documents
action_or_input: Submit the complete Draft request for formal processing
expected_result: The expense/voucher request is submitted for formal processing

purpose: Verify that formal submission of an expense/voucher request is blocked when mandatory fields are missing
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Basic User role and has a Draft request with missing mandatory fields
action_or_input: Attempt formal submission of the Draft request
expected_result: Formal submission is blocked due to missing mandatory fields

purpose: Verify that formal submission of an expense/voucher request is blocked when required documents are missing
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Basic User role and has a Draft request with mandatory fields filled but required documents missing
action_or_input: Attempt formal submission of the Draft request
expected_result: Formal submission is blocked due to missing required documents

purpose: Verify that upon successful submission, the request status becomes Submitted and it is routed to Finance Staff
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Basic User role and has a complete Draft request with required documents
action_or_input: Execute formal submission of the Draft request
expected_result: The request status transitions to Submitted and the request is routed to Finance Staff

purpose: Verify that ordinary creator editing of an expense/voucher request is prevented after submission
preconditions: An expense/voucher request exists in Submitted status created by the Basic User
action_or_input: Basic User attempts ordinary direct editing of the submitted request fields
expected_result: Direct editing is blocked and the request content remains unchanged

purpose: Verify that creator editing/correction of an expense/voucher request is permitted through supported clarification/correction response
preconditions: An expense/voucher request is under Finance review and Finance has requested clarification/correction
action_or_input: Basic User submits clarification response with required corrections/evidence
expected_result: The clarification response and corrections are accepted and recorded for the request

purpose: Verify that the system preserves a complete action and status history for an expense/voucher request
preconditions: An expense/voucher request has undergone creation, saving, and submission actions
action_or_input: Retrieve the action and status history of the expense/voucher request
expected_result: The complete history showing all recorded actions and status changes is present

purpose: Verify that Finance Staff can review submitted expense/voucher request details and supporting documents
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Finance Staff role; an expense/voucher request exists in Submitted status with attached documents
action_or_input: Finance Staff accesses and reviews request details and supporting documents
expected_result: The submitted request details and attached supporting documents are displayed and accessible for review

purpose: Verify that Finance Staff can validate expense/voucher requests against applicable financial and policy requirements
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Finance Staff role; an expense/voucher request is in Submitted status under review
action_or_input: Finance Staff performs validation against applicable financial and policy requirements
expected_result: Validation checks are executed against financial and policy requirements and validation outcome is recorded

purpose: Verify that Finance Staff can request clarification or additional evidence during validation
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Finance Staff role; an expense/voucher request is undergoing Finance review
action_or_input: Finance Staff initiates a clarification query requesting additional information or evidence from the creator
expected_result: Clarification request is recorded and the request awaits response from the creator

purpose: Verify that the concerned Basic User can respond to a Finance clarification query with information or evidence
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Basic User role; an expense/voucher request has an open Finance clarification query
action_or_input: Basic User submits response containing clarification information and attached evidence
expected_result: Clarification response and evidence are successfully recorded for the request

purpose: Verify that after a clarification response, the request returns to Finance review without losing prior history
preconditions: A clarification response has been submitted by the Basic User for an expense/voucher request
action_or_input: Check request status, queue, and action history after clarification response submission
expected_result: Request returns to Finance review status and all prior action and status history is fully retained

purpose: Verify that a request that passes Finance validation becomes Finance Validated and enters its configured approval route
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Finance Staff role; an expense/voucher request has passed all Finance validation checks
action_or_input: Finance Staff marks validation as passed / completes validation
expected_result: The request status transitions to Finance Validated and it enters its configured approval route

purpose: Verify that Finance Staff can mark an approved expense/voucher request as internally processed/recorded
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Finance Staff role; an expense/voucher request has received all required approvals
action_or_input: Finance Staff records internal processing completion for the approved request
expected_result: The expense/voucher request status transitions to internally processed/recorded

purpose: Verify that internal processing/recording states do not execute or imply a real bank transfer
preconditions: An approved expense/voucher request is marked internally processed/recorded by Finance Staff
action_or_input: Verify system operations and external gateway integrations during internal recording
expected_result: No real bank transfer or payment gateway transaction is initiated or executed; record is strictly internal governance completion

purpose: Verify that processed financial records are retained for subsequent audit review
preconditions: An expense/voucher request has reached internally processed/recorded status
action_or_input: Query the system for processed financial records as an Auditor
expected_result: The processed financial record is retained in the system and accessible for subsequent audit review

purpose: Verify that the required approval route is determined using configured request amount, request type, department, and hierarchy rules
preconditions: Approval hierarchy routing rules configured by System Admin based on amount thresholds, request type, and department
action_or_input: Submit and validate requests matching distinct configured combinations of amount, request type, and department
expected_result: Each request is assigned to the exact approval route determined by the matching amount, type, department, and hierarchy configuration

purpose: Verify that HoD, Dean, and Director are represented as distinct approval authorities and assigned according to the configured route
preconditions: Distinct users hold roles HoD, Dean, and Director; approval routes configured for each distinct authority
action_or_input: Evaluate approval routing assignments across routes configured for HoD, Dean, and Director
expected_result: HoD, Dean, and Director are handled as distinct authority roles and requests are assigned strictly to the configured authority

purpose: Verify that the assigned Approving Authority can review a routed request
preconditions: User is authenticated with the active Approving Authority role assigned to the routed request
action_or_input: Approving Authority accesses and views the routed request details and supporting documentation
expected_result: The routed request details, justification, and attachments are accessible and viewable by the assigned authority

purpose: Verify that the assigned Approving Authority can approve a routed request with recorded remarks
preconditions: User is authenticated with the assigned Approving Authority role; request is pending approval with that authority
action_or_input: Approving Authority submits approval decision accompanied by remarks
expected_result: The approval decision and recorded remarks are stored, and the approval action is recorded

purpose: Verify that the assigned Approving Authority can reject a routed request with recorded remarks
preconditions: User is authenticated with the assigned Approving Authority role; request is pending approval with that authority
action_or_input: Approving Authority submits rejection decision accompanied by remarks
expected_result: The request status transitions to Rejected and the rejection decision with remarks is recorded

purpose: Verify that the system prevents a request creator from approving that same request
preconditions: A user is the creator of a request and also holds an Approving Authority role (e.g. HoD)
action_or_input: The creator attempts to execute an approval decision on their own submitted request
expected_result: Approval is prevented due to segregation of duties (self-approval prohibited), and item is routed to next eligible authority

purpose: Verify that when another approval level is required, an approved request remains pending and routes to the next configured eligible authority
preconditions: A multi-level approval route is configured; the request has received approval at the first level
action_or_input: Execute first-level approval on the multi-level request
expected_result: Request remains in pending approval status and is routed to the next configured eligible authority in the hierarchy

purpose: Verify that a pending approval that exceeds its configured action time limit is escalated automatically
preconditions: A request is pending approval with an assigned authority; configured action time limit has elapsed without action
action_or_input: Trigger timeout evaluation / scheduled escalation check
expected_result: The pending approval is automatically escalated by the system due to exceeding the configured action time limit

purpose: Verify that an escalated approval is routed to the next eligible configured authority
preconditions: An approval action has been escalated due to timeout
action_or_input: Inspect routing assignment of the escalated approval
expected_result: The escalated approval is assigned and routed to the next eligible configured authority in the hierarchy

purpose: Verify that the assigned higher/next authority can review and resolve an escalated request by approval
preconditions: User is authenticated as the assigned higher/next authority; request is routed as escalated approval
action_or_input: Higher authority reviews and submits approval decision on the escalated request
expected_result: The escalated request is resolved with approval status and recorded decision details

purpose: Verify that the assigned higher/next authority can review and resolve an escalated request by rejection
preconditions: User is authenticated as the assigned higher/next authority; request is routed as escalated approval
action_or_input: Higher authority reviews and submits rejection decision on the escalated request
expected_result: The escalated request is resolved with rejection status and recorded decision details

purpose: Verify that the system compares the applicable request/claim amount with available departmental budget during Finance validation
preconditions: Departmental budget allocation is configured; an expense request or TA claim is undergoing Finance validation
action_or_input: Finance Staff initiates budget check during validation
expected_result: The system evaluates the request/claim amount against the remaining available departmental budget

purpose: Verify that budget insufficiency is flagged for configured review/escalation rather than automatically causing rejection
preconditions: An expense request or TA claim amount exceeds available departmental budget
action_or_input: Perform Finance validation on the budget-insufficient request/claim
expected_result: The request is flagged for configured anomaly review/escalation and is NOT automatically rejected

purpose: Verify that Finance Staff can manually flag a material anomaly or policy violation
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Finance Staff role; reviewing a financial request or claim
action_or_input: Finance Staff flags a material anomaly or policy violation on the record with description/category
expected_result: A material anomaly record is created and linked to the financial request

purpose: Verify that an Auditor can manually flag a material anomaly or policy violation
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Auditor role; reviewing a financial record
action_or_input: Auditor flags a material anomaly or policy violation on the record with description/category
expected_result: A material anomaly record is created and linked to the financial record

purpose: Verify that the system automatically creates an anomaly record for configured material anomaly conditions
preconditions: System configuration defines automatic material anomaly trigger conditions (e.g. budget insufficiency or policy thresholds)
action_or_input: A transaction occurs meeting configured material anomaly condition
expected_result: The system automatically generates a material anomaly record linked to the transaction

purpose: Verify that the system tracks each anomaly from Open until it is Resolved or Escalated
preconditions: A newly created anomaly record exists in Open status
action_or_input: Track lifecycle transitions as resolution or escalation action is taken on the anomaly record
expected_result: The anomaly record starts in Open state and transitions to Resolved or Escalated according to the recorded outcome

purpose: Verify that the designated anomaly resolver can record a resolution outcome for an anomaly
preconditions: User is authenticated as designated anomaly resolver; an anomaly record is in Open status
action_or_input: Designated resolver records a resolution outcome with justification
expected_result: The anomaly record status transitions to Resolved with resolver remarks and timestamp

purpose: Verify that the designated anomaly resolver can record an escalation outcome for an anomaly
preconditions: User is authenticated as designated anomaly resolver; an anomaly record is in Open status
action_or_input: Designated resolver records an escalation outcome with justification
expected_result: The anomaly record status transitions to Escalated with resolver remarks and timestamp

purpose: Verify that an eligible employee can submit a TA claim
preconditions: User is authenticated as an eligible employee with Basic User role
action_or_input: Submit a complete TA claim for formal processing
expected_result: The TA claim is successfully submitted and enters the processing lifecycle

purpose: Verify that the system captures TA trip dates, purpose, claimed amount, and other required trip details
preconditions: User is creating a TA claim
action_or_input: Input trip start date, trip end date, travel purpose, claimed amount, and required trip details
expected_result: All entered trip dates, purpose, claimed amount, and required details are accurately captured and stored

purpose: Verify that the employee can attach required TA supporting documents to a TA claim
preconditions: User is preparing a TA claim
action_or_input: Attach required TA supporting documents (e.g. travel tickets, boarding passes, receipts)
expected_result: The supporting documents are successfully attached and associated with the TA claim

purpose: Verify that TA claim submission is blocked when mandatory TA fields are missing
preconditions: User has prepared a TA claim omitting mandatory fields (e.g. trip dates or purpose)
action_or_input: Attempt submission of the incomplete TA claim
expected_result: TA claim submission is blocked and missing mandatory fields are indicated

purpose: Verify that TA claim submission is blocked when required documents are missing
preconditions: User has prepared a TA claim with mandatory fields filled but required supporting documents missing
action_or_input: Attempt submission of the TA claim lacking required documents
expected_result: TA claim submission is blocked due to missing required supporting documents

purpose: Verify that Finance Staff can verify a submitted TA claim for policy compliance
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Finance Staff role; a TA claim is in submitted status
action_or_input: Finance Staff reviews and verifies the TA claim against applicable institutional travel policies
expected_result: Policy compliance checks are performed and policy verification result is recorded

purpose: Verify that the system validates a submitted TA claim against applicable available departmental budget
preconditions: A TA claim has been submitted; departmental budget is configured
action_or_input: Execute budget validation check on the submitted TA claim
expected_result: The claimed amount is compared against available departmental budget and budget check status is recorded

purpose: Verify that Finance Staff can request clarification/evidence on a TA claim and the claimant can respond
preconditions: User authenticated as Finance Staff reviewing a TA claim; claimant is an eligible Basic User
action_or_input: Finance Staff issues a clarification/evidence request, then claimant submits clarification response with evidence
expected_result: Clarification request is recorded, claimant successfully submits response, and response is recorded on the TA claim

purpose: Verify that a TA claim requiring high-value approval is routed through the configured approval route
preconditions: High-value TA threshold is configured; a submitted TA claim meets or exceeds the high-value criteria and passes Finance verification
action_or_input: Complete Finance verification on the high-value TA claim
expected_result: The TA claim is routed into the configured approval route for authority decision

purpose: Verify that the assigned Approving Authority can approve a high-value TA claim with remarks
preconditions: User is authenticated with the assigned Approving Authority role for a routed high-value TA claim
action_or_input: Approving Authority submits approval decision with remarks
expected_result: The high-value TA claim is approved and the approval decision with remarks is recorded

purpose: Verify that the assigned Approving Authority can reject a high-value TA claim with remarks
preconditions: User is authenticated with the assigned Approving Authority role for a routed high-value TA claim
action_or_input: Approving Authority submits rejection decision with remarks
expected_result: The high-value TA claim status transitions to Rejected and the rejection decision with remarks is recorded

purpose: Verify that a TA claimant cannot approve their own TA claim
preconditions: The TA claimant holds an Approving Authority role (e.g. HoD or Dean)
action_or_input: The claimant attempts to approve their own submitted TA claim
expected_result: Approval is prevented due to segregation of duties (self-approval prohibited)

purpose: Verify that Finance Staff can internally process and record a verified/approved TA claim
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Finance Staff role; TA claim has completed required verification/approval
action_or_input: Finance Staff executes internal processing and recording of the TA claim
expected_result: The TA claim is marked internally processed and recorded

purpose: Verify that a processed and recorded TA claim becomes read-only and reaches its terminal recorded state
preconditions: A TA claim has been internally processed and recorded by Finance Staff
action_or_input: Attempt modification of details on the recorded TA claim
expected_result: The claim is in terminal recorded state and modifications are prevented as the record is strictly read-only

purpose: Verify that Auditors can review completed and in-process financial records within authorized scope
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Auditor role; completed and in-process financial records exist within scope
action_or_input: Auditor accesses and inspects completed and in-process financial records
expected_result: The financial records and their complete audit histories within scope are accessible for review

purpose: Verify that an Auditor can raise an audit observation linked to a relevant financial record or process
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Auditor role reviewing a financial record or process
action_or_input: Auditor submits a new audit observation specifying details, observation category, and link to the record
expected_result: The audit observation is created and successfully linked to the target financial record/process

purpose: Verify that a newly raised audit observation enters Open state
preconditions: An Auditor raises a new audit observation against a financial record
action_or_input: Check the initial state of the newly created audit observation
expected_result: The audit observation is initialized and enters Open state

purpose: Verify that the concerned user/department can submit corrective-action response information for an Open observation
preconditions: User is authenticated as the concerned user or department representative; an audit observation is in Open state
action_or_input: Submit corrective-action response information addressing the observation
expected_result: The corrective-action response details are recorded for the audit observation

purpose: Verify that supporting evidence can be attached to an audit-observation response
preconditions: Concerned user is submitting a response to an Open audit observation
action_or_input: Attach supporting evidence files/documents to the response submission
expected_result: The supporting evidence attachments are linked and saved with the audit-observation response

purpose: Verify that a submitted audit-observation response moves the observation to Responded state
preconditions: An audit observation is in Open state
action_or_input: Concerned user/department submits the completed corrective-action response
expected_result: The audit observation status transitions from Open to Responded

purpose: Verify that the Auditor can verify the response, corrective action, and supporting evidence
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Auditor role; an audit observation is in Responded state with attached evidence
action_or_input: Auditor reviews and verifies the submitted response narrative, corrective action, and attached evidence
expected_result: The Auditor can inspect all response components and record verification findings

purpose: Verify that an audit observation is closable only after Auditor verification of the response and evidence
preconditions: An audit observation is in Open or unverified Responded state
action_or_input: Attempt to close the observation prior to satisfactory Auditor verification of response and evidence
expected_result: Closure is blocked; observation can only transition to Closed following satisfactory Auditor verification

purpose: Verify that if the response is unsatisfactory, the observation returns from Responded to Open for another response cycle
preconditions: User is authenticated as Auditor; an audit observation is in Responded state
action_or_input: Auditor marks the response as unsatisfactory with rejection/unsatisfactory remarks
expected_result: The audit observation transitions from Responded back to Open state for another response cycle

purpose: Verify that audit observations cannot be deleted in a way that removes their recorded history
preconditions: An audit observation exists in the system with associated history
action_or_input: Attempt to delete or purge the audit observation record
expected_result: Deletion is prevented or rejected; the observation and its recorded history remain intact and immutable

purpose: Verify that the system provides authorized users a read-only dashboard/report of request status summaries
preconditions: User is authenticated with an authorized reporting role (Finance Staff, Approving Authority, Auditor)
action_or_input: Access the status summary dashboard/report
expected_result: Read-only request status summaries scoped to the user role are displayed accurately

purpose: Verify that the system provides approval turnaround-time information to authorized reporting users
preconditions: User is authenticated with an authorized reporting role; requests have completed approval cycles
action_or_input: Access turnaround-time reporting view
expected_result: Calculated approval turnaround-time metrics and details are displayed for authorized review

purpose: Verify that the system provides authorized reporting users information on flagged anomalies and audit observations
preconditions: User is authenticated with an authorized reporting role; anomalies and audit observations exist
action_or_input: Access reporting view for anomalies and audit observations
expected_result: Information and metrics on flagged anomalies and audit observations are displayed according to role scope

purpose: Verify that authorized reporting users can export a read-only report for offline reference
preconditions: User is authenticated with an authorized reporting role viewing a report
action_or_input: Execute report export action
expected_result: A read-only report file is generated and exported for offline reference without altering data

purpose: Verify that a Basic User can track the status and history of their own expense/voucher requests and TA claims
preconditions: User is authenticated with active Basic User role; multiple requests and TA claims exist from this user and other users
action_or_input: Basic User queries their request and TA claim status/history view
expected_result: The status and complete action history of the user own requests and TA claims are displayed, excluding other users records

purpose: Verify that the system notifies relevant actors of request/claim submission and status changes
preconditions: A request or TA claim is submitted or undergoes a status change
action_or_input: Check notification generation for relevant actors (e.g. submitter and assigned Finance Staff)
expected_result: Notifications for submission and status changes are generated for the relevant actors

purpose: Verify that the system notifies relevant actors of approval, rejection, and escalation events
preconditions: An approval, rejection, or timeout escalation occurs on a financial request or claim
action_or_input: Check notifications delivered to relevant actors (creator, prior authority, next authority)
expected_result: Notifications detailing the approval, rejection, or escalation event are generated and delivered to relevant actors

purpose: Verify that the system notifies relevant actors of anomaly and audit-observation events
preconditions: A material anomaly is flagged or an audit observation is raised
action_or_input: Check notifications generated for designated anomaly resolvers and concerned department actors
expected_result: Notifications detailing the anomaly or audit-observation event are generated for the relevant actors

purpose: Verify that the system notifies relevant actors of pending actions and overdue follow-ups
preconditions: Action items are pending or have exceeded follow-up thresholds for an actor
action_or_input: Trigger pending action / overdue follow-up notification check
expected_result: Notifications highlighting pending actions and overdue follow-ups are generated for the assigned actors

purpose: Verify that IAA notifications are visible through the Fusion dashboard
preconditions: Notifications have been generated for an authenticated user across IAA events
action_or_input: User accesses the Fusion dashboard notification view
expected_result: The generated IAA notifications are displayed and visible within the user Fusion dashboard

purpose: Verify that System Admin can assign and manage IAA roles
preconditions: User is authenticated with active System Admin role
action_or_input: System Admin creates role assignment or updates user IAA roles
expected_result: The role assignment/update is saved successfully in the system configuration

purpose: Verify that System Admin can configure approval hierarchy and threshold/routing parameters
preconditions: User is authenticated with active System Admin role
action_or_input: System Admin updates approval hierarchy levels, amount thresholds, and routing parameters
expected_result: The updated approval hierarchy and routing configuration parameters are successfully stored

purpose: Verify that System Admin can configure financial years and policy parameters
preconditions: User is authenticated with active System Admin role
action_or_input: System Admin configures financial year boundaries and institutional policy parameters
expected_result: The financial year definitions and policy parameters are successfully updated and stored

purpose: Verify that System Admin is not permitted to access operational financial request content
preconditions: User is authenticated with active System Admin role
action_or_input: System Admin attempts to view or access operational financial request content or vouchers
expected_result: Access is denied/blocked as System Admin is prohibited from operational financial request content

purpose: Verify that System Admin is not permitted to perform operational approvals
preconditions: User is authenticated with active System Admin role; a financial request is pending approval
action_or_input: System Admin attempts to approve or reject the operational financial request
expected_result: Action is blocked as System Admin has no operational approval privileges

purpose: Verify that the system requires a multi-role user to explicitly switch/activate the role used for a role-specific action
preconditions: User holds multiple roles (e.g. Basic User and HoD) and has one role active
action_or_input: User attempts an action specific to another held role without activating/switching to it
expected_result: Action requires explicit role activation/switch to the intended role before execution is permitted

purpose: Verify that role changes do not alter historical records or the recorded identity/role of completed actions
preconditions: A user performed an approval or submission under role R1; subsequently user role is changed to R2
action_or_input: Inspect previously completed audit trails and historical records for that user actions
expected_result: Historical records remain unchanged, retaining the original identity and role under which actions were performed

purpose: Verify that the system enforces role-based access control across all IAA features and data views
preconditions: User is authenticated with a role lacking permission for a restricted feature/view (e.g. Basic User accessing Finance review)
action_or_input: User attempts unauthorized access to restricted IAA features or data views
expected_result: Access is denied and RBAC enforcement blocks unauthorized interaction or data viewing

purpose: Verify that the system logs IAA actions with user identity, active role, timestamp, action, and resulting status
preconditions: An authorized user performs an operational or configuration action in IAA
action_or_input: Retrieve the audit trail log entry generated for the performed action
expected_result: The audit log records user identity, active role, timestamp, action description, and resulting status
